(@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' or t.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and t.INTRL_SCND_ORIG_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' AND (t.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL ='Y' or ( (ee.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null and COALESCE(t.ORIG_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, -1) <> t.SCND_ORIG_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID) or (ee.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and (COALESCE(t.ORIG_AUG_NM, '-') <> t.SCND_ORIG_AUG_NM or COALESCE(t.ORIG_JRSDCN_CD,'-') <> t.SCND_ORIG_JRSDCN_CD)))) and t.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > (select Min_Dt from clndr_vw) AND t.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= (select Max_Dt from clndr_vw) and t.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select Min_Dt from clndr_vw) AND (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) )wire ),
All_Trxn_R as (select a.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID ,a.bus_day_age ,min(a.Clndr_Day_Age) Clndr_Day_Age ,sum(a.trxn_am) One_Day_Amt ,max(a.trans_dt) Trans_Dt --,max(t.func_crncy_cd) Func_Crncy_Cd from (SELECT EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, bus_day_age, Clndr_Day_Age, trxn_am, trans_dt, count(distinct case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null then COALESCE(t.TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, rownum) else null end) over (partition by t.extrl_ntity_seq_id) as Other_Id, sum(case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null then 1 else 0 end) over (partition by t.extrl_ntity_seq_id) as Id_Driven, sum(case when t.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and t.TRXN_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID is null then 1 else 0 end) over (partition by t.extrl_ntity_seq_id) as Nm_Driven, count(1) over (partition by t.extrl_ntity_seq_id) as Tot_Ct from Trxns t) a where (a.Id_Driven = a.Tot_Ct or a.Other_Id > 1 or (a.Nm_Driven = 1 and a.Tot_Ct = 1)) group by a.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, a.bus_day_age ), impacted_ee as (SELECT a.DATASET_KEY, a.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, a.TRANS_DT, a.BUS_DAY_AGE, a.CLNDR_DAY_AGE, a.GRP_CD, a.TRANS_TY, a.ONE_DAY_AMT, a.TWO_DAYS_AMT, a.TWO_CONSECUTIVE_FL, a.ONE_DAY_AMT_FL, a.TWO_DAYS_AMT_FL, /*a.FUNC_CRNCY_CD,*/ a.REC_CT
FROM (select 1 as Dataset_key, g.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID , g.Trans_Dt , g.Bus_Day_Age , g.Clndr_Day_Age , 0 Grp_Cd , -1 as Trans_Ty , g.One_Day_Amt , g.One_Day_Amt + COALESCE(t.One_Day_Amt,0) as Two_Days_Amt , case when g.One_Day_Amt = (g.One_Day_Amt + COALESCE(t.One_Day_Amt,0)) then 0 else 1 end as Two_Consecutive_Fl -- it tells us if the first day fall into range , case when g.One_Day_Amt >= @LE_R1 and g.One_Day_Amt <= @UE_R1 then 1 when g.One_Day_Amt >= @LE_R2 and g.One_Day_Amt <= @UE_R2 then 1 else 0 end as One_Day_Amt_Fl -- it tells us if sum of two consecutive days fall into range and we have two consecutive days , case when ((g.One_Day_Amt + COALESCE(t.One_Day_Amt,0))>= @LE_R1 and (g.One_Day_Amt + COALESCE(t.One_Day_Amt,0))<= @UE_R1 and g.One_Day_Amt <> (g.One_Day_Amt + COALESCE(t.One_Day_Amt,0))) then 1 when ((g.One_Day_Amt + COALESCE(t.One_Day_Amt,0))>= @LE_R2 and (g.One_Day_Amt + COALESCE(t.One_Day_Amt,0))<= @UE_R2 and g.One_Day_Amt <> (g.One_Day_Amt + COALESCE(t.One_Day_Amt,0))) then 1 else 0 end as Two_Days_Amt_Fl --, g.Func_Crncy_Cd , count(1) over (partition by g.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID) as Rec_Ct from All_Trxn_R g left outer join All_Trxn_R t on g.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = t.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID and g.bus_day_age = t.bus_day_age - 1 ) a WHERE --At least one attempt (a.One_Day_Amt_Fl <> 0 OR a.Two_Days_Amt_Fl <> 0 ) -- Min Number of Attempts AND a.Rec_Ct >= @Min_Attempts ORDER BY a.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, a.Bus_Day_Age)
select distinct(EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID) as EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID from impacted_ee
